verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own product page confirms DLSS 4 AI-powered upscaling support on the RTX PRO 6000, but this is a professional/workstation card and there's no documentation of broad game compatibility lists, frame-generation specifics, or FSR support, and no independent gaming benchmarks corroborate real-world performance across titles. missing for 10: game compatibility list, frame-generation feature naming/behavior, FSR mention, independent gaming benchmarks.
